name: upstream/32/examples/control_flow/loop_control.vibe::run
source:
# vibe: 1.0

def odds_below(limit)
  out = []
  n = 0
  while n < limit
    n = n + 1
    if n == limit
      break
    end
    if n % 2 == 0
      next
    end
    out = out + [n]
  end
  out
end

def run
  odds_below(10)
end

name: upstream/33/examples/control_flow/while_loop.vibe::run
source:
# vibe: 1.0

def countdown(start)
  out = []
  n = start
  while n > 0
    out = out + [n]
    n = n - 1
  end
  out
end

def run
  countdown(5)
end

name: upstream/34/examples/control_flow/until_loop.vibe::run
source:
# vibe: 1.0

def collect_until(limit)
  out = []
  n = 0
  until n >= limit
    out = out + [n]
    n = n + 1
  end
  out
end

def run
  collect_until(5)
end

def run
  int_arith = 10 + 5 - 3 * 2 / 2
  float_arith = 10.5 + 2.5 - 1.0
  mixed = 10 + 2.5

  neg_int = -42
  neg_float = -3.14

  comparisons = {
    lt: 1 < 2,
    le: 2 <= 2,
    gt: 3 > 2,
    ge: 3 >= 3,
    eq_int: 5 == 5,
    neq_int: 5 != 6,
    eq_str: "a" == "a",
    neq_str: "a" != "b",
    eq_bool: true == true,
    eq_nil: nil == nil
  }

  bool_ops = {
    and_tt: true && true,
    and_tf: true && false,
    and_ff: false && false,
    or_tt: true || true,
    or_tf: true || false,
    or_ff: false || false,
    not_t: !true,
    not_f: !false
  }

  modulo = {
    pos: 10 % 3,
    neg_dividend: -10 % 3
  }

  string_concat = "hello" + " " + "world"

  {
    int_arith: int_arith,
    float_arith: float_arith,
    mixed: mixed,
    neg_int: neg_int,
    neg_float: neg_float,
    comparisons: comparisons,
    bool_ops: bool_ops,
    modulo: modulo,
    string_concat: string_concat
  }
end

rows=JSON.parse(input)
i=0
total=0

end

end

name: upstream_fibonacci/metered
source:
# vibe: 1.0

def factorial(n)
  if n <= 1
    1
  else
    n * factorial(n - 1)
  end
end

def fibonacci(n)
  if n <= 1
    n
  else
    fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2)
  end
end

source:
# vibe: 1.0

def countdown(start)
  out = []
  n = start
  while n > 0
    out = out + [n]
    n = n - 1
  end
  out
end

def run
  countdown(5)
end

# vibe: 1.0

def greet(name)
  "hello " + name
end

def decorated_greeting(name)
  message = greet(name)
  "[" + message + "]"
end

def sum_three(a, b, c)
  add_two = a + b
  add_two + c
end

def max_value(a, b)
  if a > b
    a
  else
    b
  end
end
